notes.title: Solendara: Chapter 2 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Solendara: Chapter 2 Update Notes

Chapter 2 Progression Unlocked


 The story progression for Chapter 2 is now available.
 New event scenes have been added.
 New weapons and abilities are introduced.


Enhanced Stats Effects


 Divinity: Affects the power of certain abilities. In addition to story progression, hidden quests and special equipment now provide additional Divinity points.
 Doctrine Insight: Increases the total resources needed to use abilities. Required for unlocking specific events and acquiring unique equipment.
 Depth of Faith: Boosts recovery from consumables. Also necessary for unlocking certain events and acquiring special equipment.
 Enchanting Presence: Plays a role in unlocking certain events and obtaining unique equipment.


Impact of Melee Weapons on Abilities


 The power of melee weapons now directly influences the effectiveness of abilities using those weapons. The degree of impact varies by ability.
 Adjustments have been made to the performance of melee weapons.


Other Updates


 Exploration relics can now be reused after a set amount of time.
 Overall weapon and ability balance has been fine-tuned.
 The cooldown for Dash has been shortened.
 A new opening sequence has been added.
 Improvements have been made to illustrations in mini-scenes.


Bug Fixes


 Bugs reported via the Survey feature have been resolved.
 Fixed an issue where characters could freeze after using abilities under specific conditions.

notes.title: Upcoming Update Plan (Chapter2)
notes.notes:
Major changes in Chapter 2

[previewyoutube=7qiZMVyTaWw;full][/previewyoutube]
If the video has been deleted, you can check the link below.
Vimeo


Storyline

 The main storyline continues.
 New abilities and weapons have been added.
 Depending on the storyline, some abilities and weapons are flame-related.



Mature Contents

 Added new cinematics and illustrated mini-scenes.
 The new scenes are designed to be more dynamic.



Combat and Exploration Changes

Bonuses have been added to some stats.

 These stats, which are used for hidden events and are useless unless they reach a certain value, have been changed to have intrinsic value.
 Doctrine Insight: Increasing this stat by 1 increases EN by 1.
 Depth of Faith: Increasing this stat by 1 increases medic kit recovery by 5.


The percentage of damage corrected by weapons for Hammer abilities has been increased.

 The damage of hammer abilities due to weapon attack power, which currently reflects less than 20%, has been changed to be heavily influenced by the weapon equipped. The percentage will vary depending on the ability.
 With this change, the damage of hammer abilities from weapon attack power will change from 0.4x to 2.8x.
 With this change, the overall balance of melee weapons has been readjusted.


Dungeon Structure Changes

 The structure of the dungeon has changed since Chapter 2, as the boss fights have become more intense and may require more retries.
 Instead of having the boss monster right before the goal, a new stage has been added only for the boss battle.


Exploration and Combat Enhancements

 I have made several new exploration and combat improvements based on the direction of the game and feedback I have received. More details will be available in the Chapter 2 Update Patch.

notes.title: Solendara Update V1.2 (EA)
notes.notes:
Solendara Update V1.2 (EA)

https://i.imgur.com/cVBjs4d.jpeg
Status-related Objects

 I've updated the map to display the remaining number of status-related objects, so you no longer have to worry about whether there are any left—the count will now appear on your screen.


Supply Chest

 I've also adjusted the supplies available from green chests. Unnecessary items have been removed from the list, and the likelihood of receiving needed supplies has been increased.


Egg

 You can now obtain more gold nuggets and chests from Eggs. I've adjusted the probabilities to increase the average amount of gold earned.


Bug Fix

 I've fixed several minor bugs that were reported. The issue where chest positions became incorrect wasn't visible in the development editor but was found only in the built game. I plan to replace it with a different object in a future patch.

notes.title: Solendara Update V1.1 (EA)
notes.notes:
Solendara Update V1.1 (EA)


[previewyoutube=AwyLj6HpssM;full][/previewyoutube]


Enemy NPC Adjustments

[olist]
 Enemy NPC attack patterns are now more varied.
 Some boss-level enemy NPCs become enraged as their HP decreases.
 ːsteamsaltyːSince this is early in the storyline, I've balanced it to avoid excessive difficulty.
[/olist]


Exploration Improvements

[olist]
 A minimap has been added.
 ːsteamsaltyːThe minimap system will be further enhanced in future updates.
 New objects have been placed to provide hints about the location of key relics.
 ːsteamsaltyːRelic of Guidance: Changes color based on distance to the target relic. Refer to in-game descriptions for more details.
 ːsteamsaltyːRelic of Vision: Temporarily displays the full map and your current location.
 New objects have been placed to grant a movement speed boost.
 ːsteamsaltyːRelic of Swiftness: Increases Marie's movement speed dramatically for 20 seconds.
[/olist]


Area Damage Attack Changes

[olist]
 Rocket launchers and radiation damage abilities now pierce through monsters, hitting all enemies in their path.
 ːsteamsaltyːPreviously, monsters in a line would act as shields for those behind them.
[/olist]


Monster Repositioning

[olist]
 More monsters will appear in temples and ruins.
 The rewards for taking alternate routes or detours have been increased.
[/olist]


Equipment and Ability Acquisition

[olist]
 Prices for equipment and abilities available from vending machines have been adjusted.
 Requirements for earning equipment and abilities through events have been revised.
[/olist]
